comment: Shape of a permission denial in `claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose` (Claude Code 2.1.316) under --permission-mode dontAsk, reduced to the fields the QA harness reads; ids and paths are placeholders. The system event carries `message` as a STRING (assistant and user events carry an object); `tool_use_id` links it to the assistant `tool_use` block and to the user `tool_result` (is_error true).

lines.message: Permission to use Read has been denied because Claude Code is running in don't ask mode.
